# OSGi I18N

> Internationalization (i18n) services for OSGi-based Java applications — creates JDK dynamic proxies from user-defined interfaces where each method call resolves to a localized message from `.properties` files.

Key facts:
- Java 1.8 source compatibility, Java 21 build/runtime
- Maven multi-module project, 2 modules
- OSGi R6 with Declarative Services 1.3
- Google Guava `LoadingCache` for lazy locale-based resolver caching
- Supports enum message translation via `EnumI18nService`
- License: Apache 2.0

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview with architecture diagrams
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, module details, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution guidelines and development workflow
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): Detailed CI/CD pipeline documentation with flow diagrams

## Modules

- [i18n-api/pom.xml](i18n-api/pom.xml): Public API — `I18nService`, `EnumI18nService` interfaces; `MessageResolver`, `MessageStreamLoader`, `LocaleProvider` SPI; `@Message`, `@MessageByKey`, `@MessageByEnum` annotations; `I18NUtil` for BCP47 locale parsing
- [i18n-resourcebundle/pom.xml](i18n-resourcebundle/pom.xml): Implementation — `I18nServiceImpl` and `EnumI18nServiceImpl` OSGi components; Guava-cached locale resolvers; `.properties` file loading with locale fallback chain; `SimpleParameterTemplater` for placeholder substitution

## Depends on

- [osgi-utils](../osgi-utils): OSGi utility library — lifecycle tracking, config monitoring, ranked services

## Used by

- [judo-runtime-core](../judo-runtime-core): Multi-module runtime engine — data access, business logic, REST, and security
- [osgi-validator](../osgi-validator): Hibernate Validator wrapped as OSGi Declarative Services component

## Optional

- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Parent POM with shared dependencies, plugin config, and profiles
- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): Main CI pipeline (build, deploy, tag, release)
- [.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml): Manual release trigger
